description_en: Queries the details of pay-as-you-go billing traffic
description_zh: 查询后付费计费流量明细
name: DescribePostpayTrafficDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。默认值为10。可设置的最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number in a paged query.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。
默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the value in the YYYYMMDD format
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询开始时间。使用YYYYMMDD格式的日期表示
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the value in the YYYYMMDD format
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询结束时间。使用YYYYMMDD格式的日期表示
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The IP address or instance ID of the asset
parameters.name: search_item

parameters.help_en:
The type of traffic boundary for statistics. This parameter is required. Valid values:
          
EIP_TRAFFIC: Internet border traffic.
  
NatGateway_TRAFFIC: NAT border traffic.
VPC_TRAFFIC: VPC border traffic
parameters.help_zh:
统计流量的边界类型。必填。取值：
          
EIP_TRAFFIC：互联网边界流量。
  
NatGateway_TRAFFIC：NAT边界流量。
VPC_TRAFFIC：VPC边界流量
parameters.name: traffic_type

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

resourceId: resource ID.
trafficDay: date
parameters.help_zh:
按照指定的字段排序。取值：

resourceId：资源ID。
trafficDay：日期
parameters.name: order

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of traffic statistics entries

InBytes.description_en: The inbound network throughput (total bytes). Unit: bytes
InBytes.description_zh: 入方向的网络吞吐量（总计字节数）。单位：Byte

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the asset instance

InstanceType.description_en: The asset type. This value takes effect only for Internet border traffic
InstanceType.description_zh: 资产类型。仅互联网边界该值生效

OutBytes.description_en: The outbound network throughput (total bytes). Unit: bytes
OutBytes.description_zh: 出方向的网络吞吐量（总计字节数）。单位：Byte

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID. For Internet border traffic, this is the public IP address of the asset. For NAT border traffic, this is the firewall instance ID of the asset
ResourceId.description_zh: 资源ID。互联网边界为资产的公网IP，NAT边界为资产的防火墙实例ID

TotalBytes.description_en: The total network throughput in both inbound and outbound directions (total bytes sent and received). Unit: bytes
TotalBytes.description_zh: 出方向和入方向总的网络吞吐量（总共发送和接收多少字节）。单位：Byte

TrafficDay.description_en: The date of the traffic statistics

TrafficType.description_en:
The type of traffic boundary for statistics. Valid values:
          
EIP_TRAFFIC: Internet border traffic.
  
NatGateway_TRAFFIC: NAT border traffic.
VPC_TRAFFIC: VPC border traffic
TrafficType.description_zh:
统计流量的边界类型。取值：
          
EIP_TRAFFIC：互联网边界流量。
  
NatGateway_TRAFFIC：NAT边界流量。
VPC_TRAFFIC：VPC边界流量
